subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Winning the championship was a dream come true for the team, but being awarded the MVP trophy was _________
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"the icing on the cake"** means something **that makes a good situation even better. **(केक पर आइसिंग)

 
 
• **Example: **Getting a promotion was great, but getting a bonus was** the icing on the cake.**
 
 
 
• **"The icing on the cake" **refers to an additional benefit or positive aspect that enhances an already good situation. (केक पर आइसिंग)
 
 
• **Example: **Winning the championship was a dream come true for the team, but being awarded the MVP trophy was **the icing on the cake.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **The silver lining **(उजाले की किरण): A positive aspect in an otherwise negative situation.

 
 
• **Example:** Losing the job was tough, but **the silver lining **was that it pushed him to start his own business.
 
 
 
• **The bird in the bush **(झाड़ी में पक्षी): Refers to something that is uncertain or not in hand.
 
 
• **Example: **He was tempted by the offer, but he knew it was just a** bird in the bush.**
 
 
 
• **A cold turkey** (ठंडा टर्की): To quit something abruptly, especially an addiction.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to quit smoking **cold turkey.**
